overrides-comment: Next pins postcss 8.4.31 inside its own tree, which has four open advisories including a path traversal that discloses arbitrary .map files. 8.5.28 is the same major, so this lifts the nested copy to the patched version without waiting on a Next release. Drop this entry once Next ships a postcss above 8.5.22 itself.
comment: The Python backend (apps/api) is not an npm workspace; it uses pip. See apps/api/README.md.
